response.sql: SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS diff_from_overall FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY (AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget)) IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average remaining is the average of remaining over all budget lines (each line weighted equally), ignoring NULLs, not the average of the per-event averages.
Budget lines with a NULL link_to_event are not treated as an event and are excluded from the per-event list, but they still count in the overall average.

alternatives.interpretation: Overall average remaining is the mean of the per-event average remaining values (each event weighted equally).
alternatives.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM e) AS diff_from_overall FROM e ORDER BY diff_from_overall IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10
